documents.text: Archibald Atkinson Archibald Atkinson (September 15, 1792 – January 7, 1872) was a U.S. Representative from Virginia. Born in Isle of Wight County, Virginia, Atkinson received a liberal education. He attended the law department of the College of William & Mary (now the Marshall-Wythe School of Law), Williamsburg, Virginia. He served during the War of 1812. He was admitted to the bar and commenced practice in Smithfield, Virginia. He was a member of the Virginia House of Delegates 1815–1817 and 1828–1831, and served in the Virginia Senate 1839–1843. Atkinson was elected as a Democrat to the Twenty-eighth, Twenty-ninth, and Thirtieth
